title: Third Time's the Charm
description: Steven talks about a deadly earthquake in Tibet and how a new group exercise only worked in his third class of the day. He also covers an awkward lunch with a student, thick smog in Beijing, his nearly full hard drives and a sharp drop in Rolls-Royce shares.

sentences.en: The main points in brief
This is the episode for Friday.

sentences.zh: Снача́ла Сти́вен говори́т о землетрясе́нии в Тибе́те.
sentences.en: First, Steven talks about the earthquake in Tibet.

sentences.zh: Пото́м он вспомина́ет своё «землетрясе́ние» в кла́ссе.
sentences.en: Then he remembers his own "earthquake" in class.

sentences.zh: Он пробова́л но́вое зада́ние в трёх гру́ппах.
sentences.en: He tried a new activity with three groups.
It only worked on the third try.

sentences.zh: Ещё он обе́дал со студе́нткой, и им бы́ло немно́жко нело́вко.
sentences.en: He also had lunch with a student, and it was a little awkward for them.
There was thick smog in Beijing.

sentences.zh: Диски́ в компью́тере Сти́вена ста́ли по́лными.
sentences.en: The drives in Steven's computer filled up.

sentences.zh: В конце́ он расска́зывает об а́кциях ко́мпании Rolls-Royce.
sentences.en: At the end, he talks about Rolls-Royce shares.

sentences.zh: Землетрясе́ние в Тибе́те и пеки́нское вре́мя
sentences.en: Earthquake in Tibet and Beijing time

sentences.zh: Вчера́ но́чью в Тибе́те бы́ло землетрясе́ние.
sentences.en: Last night there was an earthquake in Tibet.

sentences.zh: Э́то случи́лось в 10:22 ве́чера по пеки́нскому вре́мени.
sentences.en: It happened at 10:22 p.m. Beijing time.

sentences.zh: Весь Кита́й живёт по одному́ вре́мени.
sentences.en: All of China lives on one time.
But Tibet is far to the west.
The difference there is three or four hours.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому в новостя́х ска́жут «ночь», а в Тибе́те ещё светло́.
sentences.en: So the news will say "night," but in Tibet it's still light.
About 16 people died.
Steven says it's a tragedy.

sentences.zh: Но он рад, что люде́й погибло не бо́льше.
sentences.en: But he's glad that no more people were killed.

sentences.zh: В э́ти дни а́кции и так па́дали.
sentences.en: These days stocks were already falling anyway.
Bad news scares people.
It worked on the third try

sentences.zh: Вчера́ Сти́вен ду́мал: сра́ботают ли его́ тво́рческие иде́и?
sentences.en: Yesterday Steven was wondering: would his creative ideas work?
Today he found out.

sentences.zh: Он говори́т: «С тре́тьего ра́за я сде́лал всё пра́вильно. И я прошёл весь уро́к до конца́».
sentences.en: He says: "On the third try I did everything right. And I got through the whole lesson to the end."
The students worked in groups.
They read a scientific article.
They have a test soon.
Then they compared three opinions.
There were five rules for this.
With the first class, Steven made a mistake.
These are students who study the "Internet of Things" (IoT).

sentences.zh: Он дал им сли́шком мно́го сра́зу.
sentences.en: He gave them too much at once.
He said: there's no need to write it down.
Then he said: you need to write it down.
The students got confused.

sentences.zh: Они ста́ли писа́ть, а не говори́ть.
sentences.en: They started writing instead of speaking.
"This is where I made a mistake," says Steven.
Finance students and "Mister Sirski"
The third class is finance students.
They were kind and active.

sentences.zh: Они спроси́ли: как ве́жливо назва́ть учи́теля?
sentences.en: They asked: what's a polite way to address the teacher?
One guy said: "Mister Sirski."
He wasn't laughing.
He had been learning polite English.
Steven doesn't like the word "professor."
Calling him by his first name is too casual.
He loves the word "teacher."

sentences.zh: Мо́жет быть, «ми́стер Сирски́» тепе́рь ему́ подхо́дит.
sentences.en: Maybe "Mister Sirski" suits him now.

sentences.zh: Но Сти́вен шу́тит: «Я Стив. Я не ми́стер. Я веду́ подка́ст и ви́део-блог. Я иностра́нец в Кита́е».
sentences.en: But Steven jokes: "I'm Steve. I'm not a mister. I host a podcast and a video blog. I'm a foreigner in China."

sentences.zh: Иностра́нец — э́то челове́к из друго́й страны́.
sentences.en: A foreigner is a person from another country.

sentences.zh: И он добавля́ет: «Ра́зве что э́то поли́ция».
sentences.en: And he adds: "Unless it's the police."
Drawings, walks and DeepSeek

sentences.zh: Беспла́тные програ́ммы с ИИ да́ют сде́лать ма́ло презента́ций.
sentences.en: Free AI programs only let you make a few presentations.
AI is a "smart" computer.

sentences.zh: Сти́вен не хоте́л, что́бы семьи́ студе́нтов плати́ли.
sentences.en: Steven didn't want the students' families to pay.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому ка́ждая гру́ппа нарисова́ла слайд от руки́.
sentences.en: So each group drew a slide by hand.
A slide is one page of a presentation.
Then the students took a photo of the drawing.

sentences.zh: Пе́рвый класс (IoT): Оди́н студе́нт всё равно́ взял ИИ.
sentences.en: First class (IoT): One student used AI anyway.

sentences.zh: Он про́сто чита́л свой слайд вслух.
sentences.en: He just read his slide out loud.
Everyone rolled their eyes.

sentences.zh: Э́то бы́ло чте́ние, а не разгово́р.
sentences.en: It was reading, not conversation.

sentences.zh: Второ́й класс (инжене́ры): Студе́нты о́чень хоте́ли говори́ть.
sentences.en: Second class (engineers): The students really wanted to talk.

sentences.zh: Те, кто говори́т хорошо́, говори́ли до́лго.
sentences.en: Those who speak well talked for a long time.
The last group didn't have enough time.

sentences.zh: Сти́вен сказа́л: «Прости́те. Я э́то испра́влю по́зже».
sentences.en: Steven said: "Sorry. I'll fix this later."

sentences.zh: Тре́тий класс (фина́нсисты): Снача́ла они говори́ли без запи́сок, и в кла́ссе ста́ло шу́мно.
sentences.en: Third class (finance students): At first they talked without notes, and the classroom got noisy.
That's good!
Then they drew on paper.

sentences.zh: Мо́жно бы́ло вста́ть, ходи́ть и спра́шивать друг дру́га: «Эй, что э́то?»
sentences.en: You could stand up, walk around and ask each other: "Hey, what's this?"

sentences.zh: Сти́вен попроси́л DeepSeek назва́ть три слу́чайных но́мера.
sentences.en: Steven asked DeepSeek to name three random numbers.

sentences.zh: Так он вы́брал, кто бу́дет выступа́ть.
sentences.en: That's how he chose who would present.
The class watched in surprise.
The presentations went well.

sentences.zh: Сти́вен посмея́лся: студе́нты рису́ют на англи́йском!
sentences.en: Steven laughed: the students draw in English!

sentences.zh: Но он сказа́л им: «Жизнь ве́серее, и она́ не така́я серьёзная».
sentences.en: But he told them: "Life is more fun, and it's not so serious."

sentences.zh: Грамма́тику пусть проверя́ют ChatGPT и DeepSeek.
sentences.en: Let ChatGPT and DeepSeek check the grammar.

sentences.zh: «Уро́к — э́то про свобо́дную речь, а не про то́чность».
sentences.en: "The lesson is about fluent speech, not accuracy."

sentences.zh: Ещё он дал зада́ние: ви́део на две мину́ты о себе́.
sentences.en: He also gave an assignment: a two-minute video about yourself.

sentences.zh: К нему́ есть лист с девятью́ кле́тками, как в бинго́.
sentences.en: It comes with a sheet with nine squares, like in bingo.
Claude made it.
Lunch with a student
Steven wanted noodles without soup.
Noodles in soup are very hot.
It splashes.

sentences.zh: А кури́тку не снять: вокру́г ты́сяча студе́нтов.
sentences.en: And you can't take off your jacket: there are a thousand students around.

sentences.zh: В столо́вой на пе́рвом этаже́ сухо́й лапши́ не́ было.
sentences.en: In the cafeteria on the first floor there were no dry noodles.

sentences.zh: На второ́м этаже́ всё бы́ло по-кита́йски.
sentences.en: On the second floor everything was Chinese-style.
He got Lanzhou noodles.
And he forgot to ask for hot sauce.

sentences.zh: Пото́м он уви́дел одну́ из двух девоче́к из кла́сса IoT.
sentences.en: Then he saw one of the two girls from the IoT class.
She was sitting alone.
Steven sat down next to her.

sentences.zh: Он давно́ хоте́л обе́дать со студе́нтами.
sentences.en: He had long wanted to have lunch with students.
That way you can find out where the food is good.
They felt awkward.
Her friend came over and was surprised.

sentences.zh: Студе́нтка сказа́ла по-кита́йски: «Я ду́мала, он ска́жет нет».
sentences.en: The student said in Chinese: "I thought he would say no."
Then they took a photo together.

sentences.zh: Сти́вен ду́мает: мо́жет быть, че́рез го́ды э́то бу́дет ми́лая па́мять.
sentences.en: Steven thinks: maybe years from now this will be a sweet memory.
Smog and El Niño
There is thick smog in Beijing.
Steven had a scratchy throat.
At home, the air purifier was running.
Chinese newspapers blame El Niño.
It's a warm current in the ocean.
Because of it, the weather changes.
But the sunset was beautiful.

sentences.zh: Смог, Эль-Ни́ньо и землетрясе́ние — мно́го для одного́ дня.
sentences.en: Smog, El Niño and an earthquake: a lot for one day.

sentences.zh: Сти́вен пошути́л: мо́жет, он сли́шком мно́го слу́шает переда́чу «No Agenda».
sentences.en: Steven joked that maybe he listens to the show "No Agenda" too much.
AI, a book and full drives
Making videos is much easier now.

sentences.zh: А вот кни́гу из подка́стов Claude сде́лал неуклю́же.
sentences.en: But Claude made the book from the podcasts clumsily.

sentences.zh: Тепе́рь Сти́вен ви́дит так: запи́си — э́то чернови́к.
sentences.en: Now Steven sees it this way: the recordings are a rough draft.

sentences.zh: Его́ на́до почи́стить и расска́зать зано́во.
sentences.en: It needs to be cleaned up and retold from scratch.
Five chapters out of twenty are done.

sentences.zh: Диск на 8 терабайт был почти́ пуст.
sentences.en: The 8-terabyte drive was almost empty.
Now there are only 40 gigabytes left.

sentences.zh: Сти́вен нашёл ко́пии файлов на други́х диска́х.
sentences.en: Steven found copies of the files on other drives.

sentences.zh: План тако́й: оди́н диск для подка́ста, оди́н для ви́део-блога и оди́н для материа́лов по англи́йскому.
sentences.en: The plan is this: one drive for the podcast, one for the video blog and one for English materials.
ChatGPT helps sort out the folders.

sentences.zh: Так Сти́вен бережёт свои́ ба́ллы Claude.
sentences.en: That way Steven saves his Claude points.

sentences.zh: Он говори́т: «Я могу́ сде́лать намно́го бо́льше. Но тогда́ я до́лжен сде́лать намно́го бо́льше!»
sentences.en: He says: "I can do much more. But then I have to do much more!"
Rolls-Royce shares
A friend wrote to Steven in a panic.
The friend is worried about his Rolls-Royce shares.

sentences.zh: Э́то ко́мпания, кото́рая де́лает дви́гатели для самолётов.
sentences.en: It's a company that makes aircraft engines.

sentences.zh: За день цена́ упа́ла на 6,42% в Ло́ндоне.
sentences.en: In one day the price fell 6.42% in London.

sentences.zh: С августа́ она́ упа́ла почти́ на 20%.
sentences.en: Since August it has fallen almost 20%.
There's also the RSI indicator.
Right now it's 19.4.

sentences.zh: Э́то зна́чит: а́кции продава́ли сли́шком мно́го.
sentences.en: That means the shares have been oversold.
Usually the price rises afterwards.

sentences.zh: Но Сти́вен предупрежда́ет: «Ва́ши де́ньги — ва́ша пробле́ма. Не вини́те меня́».
sentences.en: But Steven warns: "Your money is your problem. Don't blame me."

sentences.zh: Лу́чшее вре́мя для поку́пки — когда́ о́чень стра́шно.
sentences.en: The best time to buy is when it's very scary.

sentences.zh: Мо́жно купи́ть одну́-две а́кции, чтобы посмотре́ть, что бу́дет.
sentences.en: You could buy one or two shares to see what happens.

sentences.zh: S&P 500 — э́то спи́сок больши́х америка́нских ко́мпаний.
sentences.en: The S&P 500 is a list of big American companies.

sentences.zh: Сти́вену ка́жется, что он держи́тся на нескольки́х гига́нтах.
sentences.en: Steven thinks it's being held up by a few giants.

sentences.zh: Мо́жно сде́лать, как, говоря́т, Уо́рен Баффе́т: купи́ть широ́кие фо́нды.
sentences.en: You can do what Warren Buffett reportedly does: buy broad funds.

sentences.zh: А пото́м игра́ть в гольф, лови́ть ры́бу или чита́ть кни́ги.
sentences.en: And then play golf, go fishing or read books.
The main takeaway

sentences.zh: Хоро́шие иде́и ча́сто на́до пробова́ть не раз.
sentences.en: Good ideas often need to be tried more than once.

sentences.zh: Заня́тие, кни́га и па́пки у Сти́вена — всё получи́лось не сра́зу.
sentences.en: The lesson, the book and Steven's folders: none of it worked out right away.
And that's normal.
You just need to try again.
